title: Jamaican Kicked Vegetable Wrap
description: A flavorful and spicy wrap filled with sautéed vegetables and a hint of Jamaican kick.
instructions: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the vegetable oil and swirl to coat.
Add the onion and bell pepper and sauté for 3-4 minutes.
Add the carrots and zucchini and sauté for an additional 4-5 minutes.
Stir in the Jamaican jerk seasoning and cook for 1 minute.
Warm the wrap in the microwave for 10-15 seconds.
Assemble the wrap by spooning the vegetable mixture onto the wrap.
Drizzle with light kick sauce and sprinkle with cilantro.
